entities.name: Videnthian Sea
entities.description: Body of water east and northeast of the Terisian Isles, separating them from Greater Videnth.

entities.name: Terisian Isles
entities.description: Islands, formerly Terisiare, west of the sea.

entities.name: Upper Videnth
entities.description: Large polar continent the sea is named after.

entities.name: Endless Sea
entities.description: Connects to the Videnthian Sea in the west.

entities.name: Sardian Mountains
entities.description: Mountains along whose north the sea ran during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War during which the sea ran along the Sardian Mountains.

entities.name: Dark Age
entities.description: Age when icebergs began forming in the sea.

entities.name: Ice Age
entities.description: Age when ice floes became ice caps connecting Terisiare with Videnth.

events.summary: During the Ice Age the ice floes coalesce into massive ice caps, connecting Terisiare with Videnth into one frozen supercontinent.
events.quote: This effectively connected Terisiare with the larger Videnth
